trigger: My life is in danger right now
description: Fast steps if you are being attacked or your safety is under immediate threat.

steps.text: Get to a safer place if you can - move toward people, light, or a public building.
Call the national emergency line now.
Then call someone you trust and tell them where you are.
Your right to life is protected by law (s.33). Say loudly where others can hear: 'Help, my life is in danger.'
If it is safe, note who is threatening you and any vehicle or details.
No one may torture or treat you in an inhuman way, including those meant to protect you (s.34(1)).
Once safe, report to the police and, if a rights violation occurred, to the NHRC or Legal Aid.
